messages:
Anna P: Quick sync — proposing a tighter set of acceptance gates + customer migration incentives for new catalog variants. Need decisions on minimum pass criteria and what migration discounts/support we offer. Thoughts?

Sanjay K: +1 on tightening. Can we get concrete numbers? e.g., latency delta threshold, cost delta, and eval pass rate.

Lina M: For evals I'd push for 95% of baseline on our core prompt suite (coverage X). Hallucination regression <1.5% absolute.

Tom R: For latency I'd prefer ±10% at p95 compared to current pinned model for same seq len. Cost delta ideally <5% but acceptable up to 10% if quality gains are material.

Anna P: Proposed acceptance matrix draft: 
- Quality: >=95% relative on product eval set, no >1.5% increase in hallucinations
- Latency: p95 <= baseline * 1.10
- Cost: per-token cost <= baseline * 1.10 (prefer <=1.05)
- Stability: 48h canary with no >1% error spike and no production rollbacks
(see inline snippet)

Sanjay K: Drop the 48h canary to 72h for high-impact models? Some customers' traffic surfaces edge cases slower.

Lina M: +1 to 72h for models used in SSO/ID workflows. For low-risk models 48h ok. We should gate by customer impact label.

Tom R: We also need an infra stress test: synthetic QPS ramp to 2x expected, KV cache warmup scenario, and failure-mode test (region outage fallback). If those fail, we mark as "infra-blocker".

Anna P: Good call. I'll add infra-blocker list. Also propose customer cohorts: 
- Tier A (SLA enterprise): opt-in migration + free 3-month migration support + 20% credits if they migrate within 60 days
- Tier B (self-serve heavy users): in-console migration wizard + 10% credits promo
- Tier C (low-use): automatic opt-in with 30-day rollback window and in-app notice

Sanjay K: Need legal & security signoff for credits / billing changes. Also ensure private deployments get the same compatibility shim.

Lina M: How do we measure quality in-customer post-migration? We should require a small 'verification' prompt set from the customer (opt-in) to watch regressions for 14 days.

Tom R: Agree. Add rollback automation: if user verification fails threshold or error spike >2x baseline, auto-fallback pin for that customer.

Anna P: Draft of launch gates I'll push to the doc: "perf, quality, infra, security, API compatibility, comms". Can we decide thresholds by EOD Friday?

Sanjay K: Friday works. I'll run numbers with infra to validate cost thresholds.

Lina M: I'll re-run the eval sweep with expanded edge prompts and share a heatmap by Thursday.

Tom R: I'll add the stress test harness to eng-releases and schedule a 2x QPS run for Wed.

E2E-bot: Canary job scheduled: catalog/canary/1918504321 started, will report in 72h.

Anna P: Perfect — last ask: does the team want a small migration incentive checkbox for sales to offer custom deals (yes/no)? If yes, define max discount cap.

Sanjay K: Yes. Cap at 30% for bespoke deals, requires sales + finance sign-off.

Lina M: +1 to cap. Also add a "no-code migration" ticket bundle we can offer (up to 8 engineering hours).

Tom R: Engineering hours bundle needs SRE on-call cushion. Let's advertise as "migration runbook + 8h eng support".

Anna P: Great. I'll capture everything in the product doc and convert these into acceptance checklist items + customer-facing comms. Will post PR link when ready. :rocket:
